sections.title: Cantonal income tax tariff (Schwyz, Tarif 2026)

source.title: ESTV Kantonsblatt Schwyz (Stand: Februar 2026), Einkommenssteuer: Steuerberechnung, §§ 36 and 36a StG

sections.basis: Taxable income, per year (simple tax, before the multipliers)
sections.note: Tariff vintage: Tarif 2026, per ESTV Kantonsblatt (Stand Februar 2026).

rows.label: Married couples and single parents
rows.value: Married couples: the rate of the taxable income divided by 1.9 (Splittingverfahren, § 36 Abs. 2 StG)

rows.label: Basic tariff: taxable income above CHF 433,500
rows.note: Für steuerbare Einkommen über 433 500 Franken beträgt die einfache Steuer für das ganze Einkommen 5 Prozent (§ 36a StG, cantonal tax).

rows.label: Tariff for the other taxes (§ 36 StG alone, without the 7% band)
rows.value: Same bands up to CHF 258,800; above that the simple tax is 3.65% of the whole income

source.title: ESTV Kantonsblatt Schwyz (Stand: Februar 2026), Einkommenssteuer: Steuerberechnung, §§ 36 and 36a StG

sections.title: Multipliers 2026: canton, cantonal capital (Schwyz; other communes differ) and church tax

rows.label: Cantonal multiplier (multiple of the simple tax)
Communal multiplier: Schwyz (cantonal capital; other communes differ)
Church tax, Reformed (multiple of the simple tax)
Church tax, Roman Catholic (multiple of the simple tax)

source.title: ESTV: Steuerfüsse der Kantonshauptorte 1995 - 2026 der natürlichen Personen (XLSX, sheet NP 2026; updated 14 September 2026)

sections.note: Total income tax = simple tax × (cantonal + communal + church multiplier); church tax only for members. The communal and church figures are those of the cantonal capital, Schwyz; other communes in Schwyz set their own multipliers. Multiples as listed by the ESTV (1.19 = 119%).
